entries.title: II Timothy 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, according to promise of life, the [life] which [is] in Christ Jesus,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:2
segments: to Timotheus, [my] beloved child: grace, mercy, peace, from God [the] Father, and Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:3
segments: I am thankful to God, whom I serve from [my] forefathers with pure conscience, how unceasingly I have the remembrance of thee in my supplications night and day,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:4
segments: earnestly desiring to see thee, remembering thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

entries.title: II Timothy 1:5
segments: calling to mind the unfeigned faith which [has been] in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and in thy mother Eunice, and I am persuaded that in thee also.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:6
segments: ¶For which cause I put thee in mind to rekindle the gift of God which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:7
segments: For God has not given us a spirit of cowardice, but of power, and of love, and of wise discretion.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:8
segments: Be not therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but suffer evil along with the glad tidings, according to the power of God;

entries.title: II Timothy 1:9
segments: who has saved us, and has called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to [his] own purpose and grace, which [was] given to us in Christ Jesus before [the] ages of time,

entries.title: II Timothy 1:10
segments: but has been made manifest now by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who has annulled death, and brought to light life and incorruptibility by the glad tidings;

entries.title: II Timothy 1:11
segments: to which *I* have been appointed a herald and apostle and teacher of [the] nations.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:12
segments: For which cause also I suffer these things; but I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep for that day the deposit I have entrusted to him.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:13
segments: Have an outline of sound words, which [words] thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which [are] in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:14
segments: Keep, by the Holy Spirit which dwells in us, the good deposit entrusted.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:15
segments: ¶Thou knowest this, that all who [are] in Asia, of whom is Phygellus and Hermogenes, have turned away from me.

entries.title: II Timothy 1:16
segments: The Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he has often refreshed me, and has not been ashamed of my chain;

entries.title: II Timothy 1:17
segments: but being in Rome sought me out very diligently, and found [me] --

entries.title: II Timothy 1:18
segments: the Lord grant to him to find mercy from [the] Lord in that day--and how much service he rendered in Ephesus *thou* knowest best.
